Symptom / friction: Blank/in-progress hybrid input left previous numeric result visible
Supported cause: input was only reconciled on change/blur
Intervention: Immediate validated draft state; suppress stale output and exports
Remaining risk / boundary: Production incidence unknown; synthetic reproduction only

Symptom / friction: Unsaved model edits lost on navigation
Supported cause: Whole-view reconstruction read only last committed defaults
Intervention: Retain nonsensitive per-model drafts in memory; show last-result notice
Remaining risk / boundary: Generic drafts are not persisted across reload; intentional

Symptom / friction: Reconnect reset a completed 12 MWh case to 10 MWh default
Supported cause: Overview reconnection overwrote the full dashboard state
Intervention: Preserve same-market model results and committed inputs; refresh pilots separately
Remaining risk / boundary: Changing market deliberately loads defaults; no cross-market merge

Symptom / friction: Unexpected Host header accepted on local API
Intervention: TrustedHost allow-list; keep existing Origin validation; loopback launcher
Remaining risk / boundary: Not authentication or a demonstrated production compromise

Supported cause: New action row had no wrap at minimum width
Intervention: Wrap small-screen actions and preserve text labels

Symptom / friction: Clicking toolbar immediately after editing could be consumed
Supported cause: Redundant blur/change replaced pointer target between mousedown and click
Intervention: Skip state-identical draft updates; assert toolbar button identity survives blur
Verification: PASS: targeted identity and journey regression
Remaining risk / boundary: Original reproduction and failed attempt retained

Symptom / friction: Named configurations and last workspace were not directly recoverable
Supported cause: Original state mostly tab-local; API runs available as exports
Intervention: Validated browser cache; server-ID-based recovery; named setup shelf
Remaining risk / boundary: Native localStorage durability not verified here; last-writer wins across tabs

Symptom / friction: Saved calculations required JSON export rather than UI reopening
Intervention: Filter history; reopen actual hybrid records with original inputs/results
Remaining risk / boundary: Latest 100 shown; other model kinds remain JSON export only

Symptom / friction: Interrupted write could be mistaken for confirmed failure
Supported cause: Network exception alone does not establish whether the server saved
Intervention: Explain ambiguous completion; no automatic write retry; inspect history
Verification: PASS: response loss injected after a real save
Remaining risk / boundary: No exactly-once server guarantee; repeated experiments are allowed

Intervention: Guided baseline/outage workflow and keyboard command palette
